{{Recipe summary

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Bread|Bread]]

{{See also|Cookbook:Cornbread}}

== Ingredients ==
*¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (35 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] / 1.2 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[cookbook:cornmeal|cornmeal]]
*1¼ cup (310 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / 10 oz) mixture of [[cookbook:milk|milk]] and [[cookbook:Orange|orange juice]] (you can use as much orange juice as you like; ¼–½ cup (60–125 ml / 2–4.2 oz) is ideal)
*1 cup (140 g / 4.9 oz) [[cookbook:flour|flour]]
*⅓ cup (75 g / 2.6 oz) white granulated [[cookbook:sugar|sugar]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[cookbook:Baking Powder|baking powder]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[cookbook:salt|salt]]
*1 [[cookbook:egg|egg]]
*¼ cup (60 ml / 2 oz) [[cookbook:Vegetable Oil|vegetable oil]]

== Procedure ==
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to 400°F (205°C). Grease a {{convert|20|cm|in|adj=on}} [[Cookbook:Baking Pan|baking pan]].
#Combine cornmeal and milk/orange juice, and let stand 10 minutes.
#Combine dry ingredients.
#Add egg and oil to cornmeal mixture, then add dry ingredients. Stir until combined.
#Pour the mixture into the baking pan.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] for 15–20 minutes.
